fields.System.Title: EPIC OUT — Outbound Fulfilment
fields.System.Description:
Goal

An order arriving from the ERP becomes a shipped box, accurately and before the carrier
cut-off.

Business value

This is the epic customers experience. Everything else in the warehouse exists to make this
work. It is also the largest epic by a wide margin, and the one with the most subtle defects —
allocation and reservation handling account for more production incidents than any other area.

Scope

In. Order intake and validation. Allocation with locking, FEFO, and shelf life rules. Wave
planning and release. Pick task generation, sequencing, assignment, and scan-verified
confirmation. Short and zero picks. Packing with verification and weight checks. Shipment
creation, manifests, and dispatch. The order status projection.

Out. Pricing, invoicing, and credit control. Carrier rate shopping and route planning.
Physical label printing — the system generates label content, a local agent prints it.

Done when

  • An order arrives via API, validates, and allocates against real stock under a lock.
  • Two orders competing for the last unit produce exactly one winner and one clean failure.
  • Cancelling an order releases every reservation, from every entry point.
  • Pick tasks are sequenced by location and confirmed with location and product scans.
  • A short pick resolves its remainder explicitly — re-allocated or shorted.
  • Packing verifies contents against the order and checks weight.
  • Dispatch moves stock out, releases leftover reservations, and notifies the ERP.

Key risks

| Risk | Why it matters | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Double allocation of the last unit | Two customers promised one unit | [doc 09 §4.1](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Deadlock on multi-location allocation | Random failures during peak | [doc 09 §4.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Reservation not released on cancel | Stock invisible forever; availability decays | [doc 09 §5.2](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Pick reduces on-hand but not reserved | Negative availability | [doc 09 §2.3](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Short pick leaves a hanging reservation | Points at stock that is not there | [doc 09 §5.4](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Adjustment invalidates an allocation silently | Picker finds an empty shelf | [doc 09 §4.5](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Wrong pick sequence | Invisible in testing; costs hours of walking daily | [doc 03 §4](../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Allocating from a projection | The same unit sold twice | [doc 09 §12](../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
